name: New York Times Digital Access
description: Free 72-hour digital passes to The New York Times online (news articles and archives back to 1851)
fullDescription: California State Library provides free digital access to The New York Times for Californians through participating public libraries.
whatTheyOffer:
- Access to NYTimes.com news articles, video, and multimedia
- Archives back to 1851
- Spanish and Chinese editions of NYTimes.com
- 72-hour passes that you can redeem again when they expire
- Does not include NYT Games, NYT Cooking, Wirecutter, or The Athletic
howToGetIt:
1. Get a library card from a participating California public library
2. Go to your library's New York Times page to get an access code
3. Create a free NYT account or log in, and redeem the code
4. Enjoy 72 hours of access
5. Return to your library's page to redeem a new code when the pass expires
keywords: New York Times, NYT, newspaper, free news, news archive, California State Library, digital access, library card
